turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: How reliable have webhooks been for your async generation jobs?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Mostly reliable, but we've had two incidents in the last quarter where webhook deliveries silently dropped and we only noticed because a customer complained about a missing audio file.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: How did you work around that?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: We built our own polling fallback on top of your webhook system, which really shouldn't be necessary. A retry-with-backoff on your end would fix this for us.
